subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If the invocation carries no task charter, the reviewer shall refuse with a named defect; if the charter is present but materially defective for review (ambiguous, self-contradictory, or contradicting the governing design), the reviewer shall escalate an upstream-defect class (FR-17) and withhold findings against the defective span.
rationale: honest scope; a broken spec is bounced, not silently reviewed against
fit_criterion: the charter-less fixture refuses; the defective-charter fixture escalates with the upstream class and withholds the affected findings; no degraded silent pass exists
